summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing its common share repurchase program transactions for July 27–31, 2026. The company, acting through a broker, repurchased 206,011 ordinary shares on Euronext Paris at a weighted average price of EUR 45.0676 per share, totaling EUR 9,284,422.75. The buyback was approved by shareholders on May 22, 2024, and aims to meet employee share option obligations. Post-transactions, the company holds 19,610,605 treasury shares (~2.2% of issued capital). This is a routine disclosure of an ongoing buyback, with no special-situation event such as tender offer or strategic review; the category is 'Other' because it is a capital allocation action, not a special situation per classifications. Watch for continued repurchase pace and treasury share usage.
